issues.summary: Codex, Cursor, and Antigravity team/model/telemetry capabilities remain unavailable unless the consumer handshake overrides the conservative registry.
Resource-win claims are forbidden until corpus benchmarks include real token telemetry.
Compatibility fields for route-task and scheduler-suggest must remain stable for one major version.
Stale or partial codebase graph evidence cannot be treated as source-grounded and codebase-memory retains its full-parity gate.
Stale, partial, conflicting, and negative-claim evidence now lowers route confidence and emits source-first fallbacks.
The SQLite learning layer was removed; optional scheduler history cannot mutate routing policy or promote lessons.
Unhealthy specialists and candidates missing tools, permissions, or adapter support are disqualified before selection.
Enforced rollout now degrades to advisory when the adapter cannot satisfy the enforcement capability contract.
